note: Offsets are load addresses (blob offset = address - 0x47000). Values labelled observed are read from the blob.

fields.0x38: 128-byte DRAM parameter block (overwritten at runtime by the selected set)

cpu_pll_registers.gate: 0x07090160 bit14 set -> CPU PLLs left untouched
cpu_pll_registers.method: park mux on 24 MHz, write N (bits 15:8), 20 us, set update bit, wait update clear + 3 lock reads (no timeout), 20 us, ungate, 20 us, then select the PLL in each mux with 20 us each

pmic_regulator_table.source: table at 0x47000+0x81e98, 36 entries x 0x6c bytes; AXP8191 over TWI
pmic_regulator_table.columns: name, min_mV, max_mV, voltage_reg, field_mask, enable_reg, enable_bit

boot0_writes.dcdc2: set to 800 or 840 mV (code then enable, no delay) at 0x1ff6; for DRAM supply
boot0_writes.dcdc4: enable set at 0x16940, voltage code untouched -> PMIC power-on default
boot0_writes.note: boot0 writes no CPU rail; DCDC3/DCDC5 read 800 mV on the board, left at PMIC default

dram_parameter_sets.source: DRAM.ext table at 0x47374, 15 slots x 0x80 bytes; selector at 0x4b2e8
dram_parameter_sets.select_mode: sys_config select_mode=3 (GPADC channel 1 + GPIO PH16); boot0 reads thresholds [163,382,608,811,1050,1315,1569,1800]

boot_package_toc.checksum: additive 32-bit sum over the padded extent, checksum field replaced with 0x5f0a6c39

handoff.jump_atf: monitor_base, uboot_base, optee_base (Jump to ATF log at 0x6055a)
handoff.scp_copy: an 'scp' item is copied to DRAM (0x48100000) but no E902 core is started
handoff.monitor_header_mutation: parser writes the DRAM size (MiB) over the monitor load word at payload+0x2c and copies 128 DRAM-param bytes at +0x30, 8 header bytes at +0x24, U-Boot/OP-TEE pointers at +0x10/+0x18, 16 id bytes at +0xb8

sys_config_keys.source: orangepi-build sun60iw2/bin/sys_config/sys_config.fex (SHA-256 eb598823...); parsed by the normal storage path, not by the RAM wrapper

dram_para.note: default block; the DRAM.ext set overrides it
